roomId.description: 直播间号（短号或长号都可以）；只填你自己的直播间

en.description: Live room id (short or full); use your own room only.

sendMode.description: 出站模式：direct=回合结束直接发弹幕（默认，需登录）；off=只听不说

en.description: Outbound mode: direct (default, needs login) posts the reply as danmaku; off only listens.

maxLength.description: 单条弹幕最多字符数（默认 20，直播等级高的账号可调大）

en.description: Maximum characters per danmaku (default 20; higher live levels allow more).

maxChunks.description: 一次回复最多拆成几条弹幕（默认 2），放不下的截断

en.description: Maximum danmaku per reply (default 2); the rest is truncated.

minSendIntervalSec.description: 两次回复的最小间隔（秒），最小 2；不足时拒绝发送，不排队

en.description: Minimum seconds between two replies, at least 2; a reply sent sooner is rejected, not queued.

master.description: 框架 master（B 站 uid）。endpoints[i].master 可逐项覆盖

en.description: Framework masters (Bilibili uid). endpoints[i].master can override this value.

items.description: 信任的 Bilibili 用户 ID

en.description: Trusted Bilibili user ID

trusted.description: 框架 trusted 用户列表（B 站 uid）

en.description: Framework trusted users (Bilibili uid).

commandPrefix.description: 命令前缀（默认 '' 无前缀，任意文本按命令匹配；如 '/' 要求 / 开头）。endpoints[i] 可逐项覆盖

en.description: Command prefix. The default empty string allows unprefixed commands; '/' requires a leading slash. Each endpoints[i] can override it.

endpoints.description: 多账号：一个插件实例挂多个 endpoint。每项与顶层字段同构（id 必填，其余覆盖顶层）

id.description: Endpoint 名称（本地标识，不是 B 站账号）

en.description: Local endpoint name, not a Bilibili account ID.

sessdata.description: Cookie SESSDATA（以你的账号身份发弹幕；请用 ${BILIBILI_SESSDATA} 注入，切勿写入仓库）。不填则匿名只读

en.description: SESSDATA cookie, acting as your account. Reference ${BILIBILI_SESSDATA}; never commit it. Omit to listen anonymously.

biliJct.description: Cookie bili_jct（csrf token，发弹幕需要；请用 ${BILIBILI_BILI_JCT} 注入）

en.description: bili_jct cookie (csrf token) needed to send danmaku. Reference ${BILIBILI_BILI_JCT}.
